decision_scope.basis: Current source facts, causal board, executable actions, renderer dependencies and composed bounds.
decision_scope.blocking_basis: Name the failed fixed criterion and the specific source or implementation that proves it. An unresolved implementation of a retained actual-film failure remains a blocker.
decision_scope.unrendered_picture: Perceived finish, foam visibility, apparent speed, cabin recognition and curve beauty are unknown without current rendered evidence. Carry uncertainty to the required exact-film review; do not invent a code-only visual rejection or approval.
decision_scope.correction: Consolidate every code-proven mandatory defect once. Optional style preferences remain notes.
decision_scope.next_gate: Code approval authorizes only the funded capture. The complete current Opus phone, native, audiovisual and independent scoring gates remain required.
